role: signals officer of the warship GVTS: you steer the scan beam and run the scan queue with the signals console keys
mission: keep the scan beam on the enemy ship and the scan queue running, so the enemy ship is identified and scanned as fast as possible

beamDirection.instructions: Which scan beam direction key do you press now?

options.right: turn the scan beam 5° further right (clockwise). Choose this to sweep for contacts beyond the omni radar: whenever the beam points less than 90° right of the nose and no contact inside the scan beam is still listed in the scan queue
options.left: turn the scan beam 5° further left (counter-clockwise). Choose this never: the sweep goes right
options.hold: press nothing: keep the beam where it points. Choose this when a contact inside the scan beam is still listed in the scan queue: it must stay in view until it is fully scanned and leaves the queue
options.centre: point the beam dead on the nose at once. Choose this when the beam points 90° or more right of the nose and no contact inside it is still listed in the scan queue, to start the sweep again

beamArc.instructions: Which scan beam width key do you press now?

options.widen: widen the scan beam 5°: it covers more of the sky but reaches less far. Never needed: the omni radar already sees all around to about 49 km
options.narrow: narrow the scan beam 5°: it reaches farther but covers less; at its narrowest, 5°, it reaches about 70 km, beyond the omni radar, where unseen contacts may lie. Choose this when the beam is wider than 5°
options.hold: press nothing: keep the beam width. Choose this when the beam is 5° wide

pauseJobs.instructions: Which do you do with the scan queue pause switch now?

options.on: pause the scan queue: nothing is scanned while it is on. Choose this never during a fight
options.off: run the scan queue: contacts are scanned in turn. Choose this when there is anything to scan, which is always during a fight
